response.sql:
SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(order_item_id) AS line_item_count
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
GROUP BY invoice_number
UNION ALL
SELECT i.invoice_number, NULL AS average_cost_ratio, 0 AS line_item_count
FROM Invoices AS i
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    WHERE ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
)
ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, invoice_number
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A zero derived_product_cost does not yield a defined ratio, so those line items are excluded from the average; invoices with no line items have a NULL average.
